# Texas Smart Cities Project

> > AI-powered platform providing real-time monitoring, data analytics, and IoT solutions for urban resilience and sustainability challenges.

The Texas Smart Cities Project, hosted by TACC (Texas Advanced Computing Center) at the University of Texas at Austin, develops intelligent systems and visualizations to address pressing urban issues including wildfire monitoring, energy management, and water sustainability. The platform integrates machine learning, IoT sensors, and advanced computing to support city planning, disaster response, and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Smart Cities
- Internet of Things (IoT)
- Machine Learning
- AI Applications
- Fire Incident Monitoring
- Real-time Data Analytics
- Urban Resilience

- Pecan Street

## Real-Time Monitoring & Visualization

- [Active Fire Incidents Map](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/FireIncident/FireIncidentMap.html): National fire tracker with real-time monitoring and air quality data integration
- [Active Fire Incidents Map - 3D Visualization](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/FireIncident/3D/): 3D visualization of active fire incidents with smoke tracking and forecasts
